## Summary

Describe the focused change, the user or contributor impact, and why it belongs in DiffLens.

## Validation

- [ ] Install from the committed lockfile
- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Unit/integration tests
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Relevant E2E checks

List any check that was not run and explain why.

## Safety / Scope Review

- [ ] No secrets, customer data, private exports, or debug artifacts are included.
- [ ] Local-first/privacy boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] Comparison semantics are preserved or deliberately documented and tested.
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated when required.
